title: Dr. Niaz Ali Successfully Defends PhD Thesis in Economics
text:
Campus News

Dr. Niaz Ali Successfully Defends PhD Thesis at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Mardan | 25 August 2026 | Department of Economics, AWKUM

Glimpses from the public PhD defence held at the Central Library, AWKUM

Mardan:
Dr. Niaz Ali, PhD Scholar in the Department of Economics at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, successfully defended his PhD thesis in a public defence held on
25 August 2026
at the Central Library of the University.

His thesis, titled
“Exploring the Role of Political Business Cycles in Economic Policies and Outcomes in Pakistan,”
examines the influence of political business cycles on economic policymaking and outcomes in the country. The research addresses an important and policy-relevant area of economics and contributes to a deeper understanding of the relationship between political processes and economic performance in Pakistan.

The thesis was supervised by
Prof. Dr. Muhammad Tariq
and co-supervised by
Prof. Dr. Muhammad Azam Khan
.

It was evaluated by
Dr. Devika Hazra
of California State University, Los Angeles, USA, and
Dr. Efrem Castelnuovo
of the University of Padua, Italy. The local examiners were
Dr. Iftikhar Ahmad
of the Pakistan Institute of Development Economics (PIDE), Islamabad, and
Dr. Abdul Qayyum
of COMSATS University, Wah Cantt.

As part of his doctoral research, Dr. Niaz Ali has published two research papers in reputable journals and one paper in conference proceedings, further demonstrating the academic significance and scholarly contribution of his work.

The Department of Economics and Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan extend their heartfelt congratulations to Dr. Niaz Ali, his supervisor and co-supervisor, and his family on this significant achievement. The University wishes him continued success in his future academic and professional endeavours.
